title: dianthus androsaceus
intro: Dianthus androsaceus, commonly known as Fringed Pink, is a flowering plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating skin conditions, wounds, and inflammation, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus androsaceus include soothing and calming effects, which may help to reduce anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
